answer: Bind each key to one exclusive, live-checkable backing. The agent commits H(address || resource id || epoch seed) and locks coins for several epochs in a dedicated haven only that key can later withdraw from. Any established peer may push a fresh nonce and demand a signed response from it; if two keys hash to one resource, or it stays mute, both bonds are slashed and rubber-stamp graders lose seat weight. Anyone can replay the nonce check, so the resource is a bridge from a cheap new key to a costly identity, and a failed proof is a public signal that one operator reused a single backing.
